description: Geocentric tropical longitude, sign and degree, ecliptic latitude, daily speed and retrograde flag of the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto and the mean North Node at a moment, 1900–2100. Computed live from the ephemeris (astronomy-engine, about 1′), tropical zodiac on the true ecliptic of date, geocentric, UTC. Astronomical positions only, no interpretation. Paid tool: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.

datetime.description: Moment as ISO UTC timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.
